description: You are given three functions that return string_view values. The exercise leaves each lifetime judgment to you.

steps.description: f1 declares a static string and returns a view from s.
f2 accepts a string by const reference and returns the expression s.substr(0, 3).
f3 returns a string literal through its string_view return type. Compare the three supplied expressions in your own analysis.

title: Inspect three string-view exercises
